text:
jamie-sales: Heads-up1: kickoff prep for Aurora pilot next Tue 9am PT. Need final scope, security sign-off, and pricing confirmation. I added a short kickoff doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/aurora-pilot-kickoff (pls skim)

alex-se: I'll bring a lightweight eval harness. Q for customer: do you prefer sample-from-prod or synthetic adversarial prompts for the initial 2k evals?

lara-aurora: We can provide anonymized prod queries + a labeled 400-row relevance set. No PII. Also want a few domain-specific prompts for assisted authoring flows.

sam-ml: Proposed success criteria:
- Quality: NDCG@10 >= +7% over current ES baseline on labeled set
- Latency: p95 <= 350ms on dedicated instance (32 tokens)
- Cost: <= $0.40 per 1k inferences for pilot
- Safety: hallucination rate < 2% on curated QA set
Also reliability: error rate < 1% over 48h soak.

alex-se: Sounds good. I'll include NDCG, latency, and an explicit hallucination check in the harness. Minimal prompt template I'll drop into the doc:
```
PROMPT = "Query: {q}\nContext:\n{docs}\nRespond concisely, cite doc IDs"
METRICS = ["NDCG@10","HallucinationRate","ResponseLatency_ms"]
```

mike-security: Security questionnaire progress: most items complete. Outstanding: KMS integration flow for Dedicated and SOC2 evidence for the infra tier. ETA: tomorrow EOD for KMS details, SOC2 docs by Fri.

lara-aurora: Residency note: data must stay in US or UK. Can Redwood pin Dedicated to us-west + eu-west only? Also retention: default logs 30d, but customer may request 90d.

sam-ml: Yes, we can region-pin. Retention can be extended via SOW. I'll add language for 90d option.

jamie-sales: Timeline from customer: 3-week pilot starting Apr 1. Proposed milestone map:
W0 (kickoff): data handoff + security cleared
W1: staging evals + baseline comparison
W2: tuning, prompt engineering, integration tests
W3: canary in customer staging + sign-off
Can we meet that if data and security finish this week?

alex-se: We need data by Wed and security closed by EOD Thu to hit those milestones. I'll allocate a small tuning pool for them.

christine: I'll join kickoff to cover infra/network and onboarding steps. Will need VPN details and service account setup from Aurora.

jamie-sales: Pricing ask from Aurora: pilot discount + clear overage terms. Sales proposal idea: flat pilot credit that covers up to X tokens OR 50% off hosted rates for 3 weeks. I'll DM draft pricing card to @lara-aurora.

alex-se: One more: can we get a quick contact in Aurora for legal to speed contract tweaks? Saves back-and-forth.

lara-aurora: Yes, cc'ing legal lead will help. I'll add them to the doc and the kickoff invite.

deploy-bot: [deploy] eval-run queued by alex-se	1 run_id=aurora-pilot-2024-04-01

sam-ml: Action items:
- alex-se: eval harness + prompt templates (due Tue)
- sam-ml: SLA/retention language for SOW (due Tue)
- mike-security: KMS + SOC2 docs (KMS by Thu EOD, SOC2 by Fri)
- lara-aurora: anonymized sample + labeled subset (due Wed)
- christine: infra checklist + VPN instructions (add to kickoff doc)

jamie-sales: I'll send calendar invite and the finalized kickoff agenda. If any blocker pops up (data/security/legal), flag here immediately. Thanks! :rocket:
